mentions.name: Game Gear hardware test ROMs
mentions.description: A collection of test ROMs run on multiple revisions of Game Gear hardware to probe its behavior; the hardware remains poorly understood, and the testing has exposed errors in Game Gear emulators.
mentions.problem: The Game Gear hardware is poorly understood, as evidenced by errors in its emulators.
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been running a bunch of test ROMs on multiple revisions of hardware, and oh boy is that thing poorly-understood, if emulator errors are anything to go by.

evidence.value: I've been running a bunch of test ROMs on multiple revisions of hardware, and oh boy is that thing poorly-understood, if emulator errors are anything to go by.
